title: Create the FY27 capital-project portfolio model
prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/FY27 capital project portfolio - 7.4.xlsx`

Begin with the July capital-committee and long-range-plan thread in `Requests/`, including the post-committee clarification. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: determine which controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts are current, use prior versions only for permitted comparison, and resolve conflicts from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Build the deliverable from the shared company sources and do not copy an output produced by another task.

Create `Projects`, `Cash Flow Models`, `Portfolio Selection`, and `Checks`. Model each project's after-tax cash flows, depreciation tax shield, working-capital investment/release, terminal value, NPV, IRR, payback, and downside NPV. Select the highest-NPV feasible portfolio subject to annual cash, debt, technician-capacity, and mandatory-safety constraints. Formulas—not hardcoded rankings—must drive the selected portfolio. Include formula-driven `Portfolio NPV` and `Downside portfolio NPV` headlines that aggregate only the selected projects, plus an independent selection-tie control proving the headlines use exactly the selected set, and cash, constraint, valuation, and source controls.

Document the controlling sources inside the deliverable. Recalculate or render as appropriate and save to the exact target path. The file is graded.
